summary: Lisata Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing its September 17, 2026 acquisition of Marea Therapeutics via a reverse-triangular merger. Lisata issued Marea stockholders 1,793,129 common shares plus 211,365.213 Series C non-voting convertible preferred shares, each convertible into 1,000 common shares pending a stockholder Conversion Proposal. The deal is intended as a tax-free reorganization; no cash price, premium, or advisor was stated. The Series C structure creates a convertible overhang subject to approval, with existing Lisata shares remaining outstanding. Watch the conversion vote, resulting ownership split, Nasdaq listing mechanics, and related management changes.
